The failure is caused by a bug in the frozen driver at [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L118-L131): in `parse_time`, the check `if ap == "pm" and h <= 12:` adds 12 hours when `h == 12`, turning `"12:30 pm"` into `"24:30"` instead of `"12:30"` (whereas [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig#L122) has `h < 12`). As a result, `Driver.match_slot` finds no slot ending in `"24:30"` even when a `12:30` slot is open.

Because the cause is in `clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py` (part of the frozen reference driver), this is a `finding` and no files were modified.

hypotheses.cause: In clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py, parse_time uses `if ap == "pm" and h <= 12:` instead of `h < 12`, converting "12:30 pm" to "24:30" rather than "12:30". Consequently, Driver.match_slot fails to match open 12:30 slots.
